notes.title: HOLYHUNT now available on PS5, PS4, Xbox and Switch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792070/52f521b4e93fe120b1facc4e6ef7bde25dad37b4.png

HOLYHUNT now available on PS5, PS4, Xbox and Switch!

Slay demons in 8-bit glory in your favorite console! 

Xbox version contains a juicy 2000G in Achievements for those that hunt not only the holy, but also those lovely gamerscore points!

Playstation features nice trophies for trophy hunters too!

Enjoy the hunt!
